method: Scope

All 146 public repositories in co-cddo, taken from GitHub's own page data on 08 October 2026 and checksum-verified (GitHub reported 146). Private and internal repositories are not visible without an organisation-owner export and are not in this inventory.
Column colours

Blue header band = OBSERVED (reproducible from git history or the GitHub listing). Green = CALCULATED by formula. Amber = ASSESSED (Claude's judgement from name, description, README, contributors and code references) — treat as a proposal to confirm with owners.
Activity source
Treeless clones of every repo; all branches; merge commits excluded. Bots (dependabot, renovate, github-actions, *-bot) excluded from 'human' counts. 'Last any commit' includes bots.
Activity status rule
Empty = no commits; Archived = archived on GitHub; Active = last human commit <=90 days; Maintained = <=365 days; Dormant = <=730 days; Inactive = older. Applied by formula on the Inventory sheet.
Contributors ('active users')

Git commit authors only. Identities merged when they share an email or name; the same person using different names AND emails (for example, one person using a different name and a different email address)') is still counted twice, so author counts are UPPER BOUNDS. Readers of the repo, issue/PR participants and deployers are not captured.
Owners

CODEOWNERS file where present (only 24 of 146 repos have one). Note: '@gds-idea-senior-ds' lacks an org prefix, so GitHub treats it as a user, not a team — likely non-functional today. Org teams (@co-cddo/...) do not transfer and must be recreated in gds-dtx.
Org coupling

For the 79 repos with any commit in the last ~13 months, a shallow clone at HEAD was searched for 'co-cddo' and 'cddo.cabinetoffice' (lockfiles excluded) and each hit classified: reusable workflow (uses:), OIDC trust (repo:co-cddo/), package/module source, GitHub Pages URL, team ref, hard-coded org, domain, doc link. Older repos were not scanned (coupling_scanned = FALSE).
Forks
Fork parents confirmed from each repo page. For upstream forks, commit activity and contributors are mostly the upstream project's.
Listing metadata

Description, language, topics, licence, stars, forks, open issues and pull requests come from GitHub's own page data for the organisation listing (read in a browser, 8 October 2026). Version 3 used summarised page reads, which missed 5 repositories (defect D1).
GitHub behaviour relied on

docs.github.com 'Transferring a repository': web and git URLs redirect; GitHub Pages URLs do NOT redirect; creating a repo at the old path deletes the redirect. 'Renaming a repository': Actions `uses:` references to a renamed repo are NOT redirected. Transfer behaviour for `uses:` is not documented — treat as not redirected. 'Deleting an organization': name becomes reusable after 90 days.
Base rate / caution

Only 37 of 146 repos (25%) had a human commit in the last 90 days, and 20 of those are one GDS IDEA cluster. Most of the estate is archive-or-delete; the migration effort is dominated by a small, tightly coupled set.
Strongest case against this inventory

(1) It cannot see private/internal repos, which are where live service code most often sits. (2) Commit recency is a proxy for use: a dormant repo can still be deployed (e.g. a Terraform module pinned by SHA, an MTA-STS policy served by Pages). (3) Classification is inferred, not stated by owners. Mitigations: dependency edges are listed in 'Dependencies'; custom domains/Pages are flagged; every destination marked 'confirm' or 'DECISION' needs an owner sign-off. Get an org-owner export (gh api /orgs/co-cddo/repos?type=all plus team and collaborator listings) to close gap (1).
Sources

github.com/orgs/co-cddo/repositories (pages 1-5); git clones of github.com/co-cddo/<repo>; github.com/orgs/gds-dtx/repositories; github.com/gds-dtx; GDS Way 'Use GitHub' (gds-way.digital.cabinet-office.gov.uk/standards/source-code/use-github.html); docs.github.com transfer, rename, Pages and org-deletion pages; repo pages for alphagov, i-dot-ai, no10ds and others listed in 'Related repos'.
